```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

PCGR_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/pcgr_outputs"
DIR  <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/Downstream/Mutational_Signature"
OUTFILE  <- file.path(DIR, "msigs.csv")

dir.create(OUTDIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Find all msigs TSVs (one per sample directory)
files <- list.files(
  path = PCGR_DIR,
  pattern = "\\.pcgr\\.grch38\\.msigs\\.tsv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("No *.pcgr.grch38.msigs.tsv files found under: ", PCGR_DIR)
}

message("[INFO] Found ", length(files), " msigs files")

# Read + keep only needed columns
all_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(files, function(f) {
  dt <- fread(f, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, data.table = TRUE)
  needed <- c("sample_id", "signature_id", "prop_signature")
  missing <- setdiff(needed, names(dt))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    stop("Missing columns in ", f, ": ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  dt[, ..needed]
}), use.names = TRUE, fill = FALSE)

# Optional: sort nicely
setorder(all_dt, sample_id, signature_id)

fwrite(all_dt, OUTFILE)
message("[DONE] Wrote: ", OUTFILE)

```

```{r}
INFILE <- file.path(DIR, "msigs.csv")
OUTFILE <- file.path(DIR, "SBS_Merged_Categories.csv")

if (!file.exists(INFILE)) {
  stop("Input file not found: ", INFILE)
}

dt <- fread(INFILE)

# Ensure correct types
dt[, prop_signature := as.numeric(prop_signature)]

# --------------------------------
# 7 Biological Bucket Mapping
# --------------------------------
bucket_map <- function(sig) {
  sig <- toupper(sig)

  if (sig %in% c("SBS1", "SBS5")) return("Clock-like/Aging")
  if (sig %in% c("SBS2", "SBS13")) return("APOBEC/AID")
  if (sig == "SBS3") return("HR deficiency")
  if (sig %in% c("SBS6", "SBS15", "SBS21", "SBS26", "SBS44")) return("MMR deficiency")
  if (sig %in% c("SBS10A", "SBS10B")) return("POLE proofreading defect")
  if (sig %in% c("SBS7A", "SBS29", "SBS90", "SBS18", "SBS9")) return("Exposure-related")

  return("Unknown/Uncharacterized")
}

dt[, Biological_Categories := vapply(signature_id, bucket_map, character(1))]

# --------------------------------
# Sum per sample per bucket
# --------------------------------
bucket_sum <- dt[
  , .(bucket_prop = sum(prop_signature, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(sample_id, Biological_Categories)
]

# --------------------------------
# Convert to relative contribution
# --------------------------------
bucket_sum[, total := sum(bucket_prop), by = sample_id]
bucket_sum[, Relative_contribution := bucket_prop / total]

# Ensure all 7 categories present for every sample
all_cats <- c(
  "Clock-like/Aging",
  "APOBEC/AID",
  "HR deficiency",
  "MMR deficiency",
  "POLE proofreading defect",
  "Exposure-related",
  "Unknown/Uncharacterized"
)

complete_dt <- CJ(
  sample_id = unique(bucket_sum$sample_id),
  Biological_Categories = all_cats,
  unique = TRUE
)

final_dt <- merge(
  complete_dt,
  bucket_sum[, .(sample_id, Biological_Categories, Relative_contribution)],
  by = c("sample_id", "Biological_Categories"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

final_dt[is.na(Relative_contribution), Relative_contribution := 0]

# Order nicely
final_dt[, Biological_Categories := factor(Biological_Categories, levels = all_cats)]
setorder(final_dt, sample_id, Biological_Categories)

# Write
fwrite(final_dt, OUTFILE)

cat("[DONE] Written:", OUTFILE, "\n")
```
```{r}
INFILE <- file.path(DIR, "SBS_Merged_Categories.csv")

OUT_PNG <- file.path(DIR, "SBS_Merged_Categories_stackedbar.png")
OUT_PDF <- file.path(DIR, "SBS_Merged_Categories_stackedbar.pdf")

dt <- fread(INFILE)

# ---- safety checks ----
req <- c("sample_id", "Biological_Categories", "Relative_contribution")
miss <- setdiff(req, names(dt))
if (length(miss) > 0) stop("Missing columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

dt[, Relative_contribution := as.numeric(Relative_contribution)]
dt[is.na(Relative_contribution), Relative_contribution := 0]

# ---- enforce consistent category order ----
cat_levels <- c(
  "Clock-like/Aging",
  "APOBEC/AID",
  "HR deficiency",
  "MMR deficiency",
  "POLE proofreading defect",
  "Exposure-related",
  "Unknown/Uncharacterized"
)
dt[, Biological_Categories := factor(Biological_Categories, levels = cat_levels)]

# ---- optional: order samples by Unknown (or any category) ----
# This makes the plot easier to read (comment out if you want original order)
ord <- dt[Biological_Categories == "Unknown/Uncharacterized",
          .(unk = sum(Relative_contribution)), by = sample_id][order(-unk), sample_id]
dt[, sample_id := factor(sample_id, levels = ord)]

# ---- plot ----
p <- ggplot(dt, aes(x = sample_id, y = Relative_contribution, fill = Biological_Categories)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Merged SBS biological categories (relative contribution per sample)",
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Relative contribution",
    fill = "Biological category"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

# Print to screen
print(p)

# Save high-res PNG
ggsave(OUT_PNG, p, width = max(10, length(unique(dt$sample_id)) * 0.35), height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Save PDF (vector)
ggsave(OUT_PDF, p, width = max(10, length(unique(dt$sample_id)) * 0.35), height = 6)

cat("[DONE] Wrote:\n", OUT_PNG, "\n", OUT_PDF, "\n")
```
